entities.summary: Ronja Savolainen is a Finnish ice hockey defenceman for the Ottawa Charge of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL) and member of the Finnish national ice hockey team. She was drafted eighth overall by the Charge in the 2024 PWHL draft and signed a three-year contract with the club in September 2024.
